maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly recurring telecom subscriptions (mobile, broadband, enterprise connectivity) in Guyana, Bermuda, Caymans and the US, not repair work.

publicly_funded.reason: Most revenue comes from consumers and businesses paying for telecom services; government subsidies like Universal Service Fund are a minority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by investing in and operating its own networks in existing markets, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Local network operator providing essential connectivity in remote markets with few alternatives; switching means disruption.
